tests.cmd: SYS JSON schema then SYS JSON ok without re-READ

weaknesses.title: SYS JSON multi-key requires re-READ of full body each time
weaknesses.detail: SYS JSON overwrites LAST with the extracted field. A second SYS JSON "ok" without SYS READ again yields OK=0 and empty LAST — no sticky last_err, so run -s still passes. Plate RMW agents silently drop fields unless they re-READ between every key.
weaknesses.repro: SYS READ plate; SYS JSON "schema"; SYS JSON "ok" → second extract empty OK=0

weaknesses.title: SYS READ/WRITE fatals have err_line=0 and empty err_src
weaknesses.detail: Missing plate file (READ) or missing STATE parent (WRITE) set last_err to OS text but never attribute source line. Boot orchestrators that fail mid-chain are hard to debug from agent plates alone.

weaknesses.title: No soft SYS READ OR / SYS TRY READ — must shell EXIST-gate
weaknesses.detail: Missing optional prior plate cannot be probed with soft READ. Pattern is SYS EXIST then branch; bare READ is hard-fatal. Agents want optional plate load without FAIL/PASS/CLEAR_ERR ceremony.
weaknesses.repro: first boot without EXIST → would abort; program must EXIST-gate

weaknesses.title: Soft INCLUDE chain requires CLEAR_ERR per miss for run -s
weaknesses.detail: Three nested INCLUDE OR misses each leave sticky last_err. Without PASS+CLEAR_ERR after every miss, -s fails the whole boot despite intentional soft path. Verbose and easy to under-clear in long orchestrators.
weaknesses.repro: INCLUDE OR a; INCLUDE OR b; STATUS; run -s without CLEAR_ERR → ok=false

weaknesses.title: Dynamic plate fields (degraded, soft_miss, uid) still not writable as live JSON
weaknesses.detail: Program writes static {"degraded":0} even when LET degraded may be 1. Building JSON from vars still needs multi-CAT and quote hell; orchestrator plate lies about runtime degraded bit unless agents use VARS/PRINT_JSON instead of the file.
weaknesses.repro: force soft_miss > BOOT_MAX_SOFT and inspect BOOT_ORCH.json degraded field stays 0

weaknesses.title: DEFAULT then ENV override needs manual IF; no DEFAULT FROM ENV form
weaknesses.detail: DEFAULT BOOT_MODE = "full" then SYS ENV OR "" + IF to override is correct but verbose. Real boot scripts want DEFAULT FROM ENV "CUBALC_BOOT_MODE" OR "full" in one form.

workarounds: SYS EXIST path before every optional SYS READ
Re-SYS READ full plate body before every SYS JSON key extract
PASS + CLEAR_ERR after each INCLUDE OR miss when using run -s
Emit truth via PRINT_JSON/VARS; treat file JSON as coarse schema stamp until WRITE_JSON exists
Probe libs with SYS WHICH when INCLUDE body has side effects
language_gaps: SYS READ OR / soft-read optional files
SYS JSON multi-extract without re-READ (or JSON object cursor)
SYS WRITE_JSON / template plate builder from vars
DEFAULT FROM ENV name OR fallback one-liner
Batch CLEAR_ERR policy or soft-scope for orchestrator chains
